acquisition method: MS/MS data on timsTOF Pro were acquired... using the DDA-PASEF method... MS/MS data on Exploris were acquired in a data-dependent strategy
alkylation reagent: an alkylation (55 mM IAA in 25 mM NaHCO3; 30 min, room temperature, 750 rpm) step
alkylation concentration: an alkylation (55 mM IAA in 25 mM NaHCO3; 30 min, room temperature, 750 rpm) step
cleavage agent: the gel pieces were incubated with 125 ng trypsin (Proteomics grade; Merc) in 50 mM NaHCO3
collision energy: HCD MS/MS spectra (isolation window m/z 1.2, 30% relative fragmentation energy) were acquired
enrichment method: separation of protein complexes by Clear-Native Polyacrylamide Gel Electrophoresis (CN-PAGE)
fractionation method: separation of protein complexes by Clear-Native Polyacrylamide Gel Electrophoresis (CN-PAGE)
fragmentation method: HCD MS/MS spectra (isolation window m/z 1.2, 30% relative fragmentation energy) were acquired
instrument: connected to either Orbitrap Exploris 480 (Thermo Fisher Scientific) or timsTOF Pro (Bruker) spectrometers
ionization type: the analytical column was installed in the EASY-Spray ion source... the analytical column was placed inside the Butterfly Heater... and its emitter side was installed inside the CaptiveSpray ion source
labeling: Relative protein abundance was assessed using protein intensities calculated by MaxQuant
reduction reagent: each band was subjected to a protein reduction (10 mM DTT in 25 mM NaHCO3, 45 min, 56°C, 750 rpm)
reduction concentration: each band was subjected to a protein reduction (10 mM DTT in 25 mM NaHCO3, 45 min, 56°C, 750 rpm)
